main_text.head: LEXICON NOVUM Chaldaeo-Biblicum, In Danielem & Esram.
main_text.l: אֲבִיהָךְ tui, No. f. & pl. aff. R. אבה voluit.
אַבְנָא lapis, No. emphat. R. אבן.
אַבְיָא queram, fut. Peh. R. בעא.
אַגְרְתָא vel אִגַּרְתָּא epistola, No. f. emph. R. אגר.
אֱדֵין tunc, בֶּאֱדֵין in tunc, R. אדן.
אַדְרַזְנְרַיָּא senatores, No. pl. emph. R. אדרג.
אַדְרִזְרָא diligenter, part. adv. R. אדר.
אַהוֹדְעֲנָה notum faciam ei, fut. aph. aff. R. ידע.
אָזְדָא abjit, Part. f. peh. R. אזל.
אָזֵה accensa, part. pehil, pro אָזָה vel אָזֵי, R. אזה.
אָזַל abjit, אֲזָלוּ profecti sunt, אֲזָלוּ fuisse[?], אָזַל
abi, præt. peh. 3. f. & pl. & 1. pl. ut & Imp. R. אזל.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-free Chaldee forms are transcribed from a small, blurred scan; every Hebrew word is doubtful and should be checked against the original (vowel points especially). Marked [?]: אָבִיךָ line 1 right-hand form; line 2 אֲבִיהָם; line 3 אֲבִיהֶנָא; the form after "profecti sunt" (printed as "fuisse" or "fuerunt"); the catchword. The left-column reference "R. אבה" and the Hebrew in the right column "אָזְדָא" may be misread. The section letters "א ב" are a bare letter heading and are kept as a paragraph. Printed roman lines are copied as printed, with the printer's spelling "abjit", "tunc", "Peh." etc. The page is mostly a lexicon list, so each printed line is one <l>. Digitiser stamp ("Digitized by Google") is left out.
